name: PHP2Shell - Patched PHP runtime
description: PHP2Shell demo: require PHP 8.5.12 or newer in the 8.5 branch. The demo remedy installs pre-staged official PHP 8.5.12 binaries and reloads PHP-FPM. Only assign this deployment-specific remedy to the isolated PHP demo host.

_remedy.command: cp /opt/lea-remediation/php /usr/local/bin/php.lea-new && chmod 755 /usr/local/bin/php.lea-new && mv /usr/local/bin/php.lea-new /usr/local/bin/php && cp /opt/lea-remediation/php-fpm /usr/local/sbin/php-fpm.lea-new && chmod 755 /usr/local/sbin/php-fpm.lea-new && mv /usr/local/sbin/php-fpm.lea-new /usr/local/sbin/php-fpm && kill -USR2 $(cat /tmp/php-fpm.pid) && php-fpm -v
